summary: The ChangePasswordNoMaster file handles the functionality for changing user passwords within the HSPnet system. It includes validation for password requirements, user session management, and UI elements for error and warning messages.
purpose: To facilitate secure password changes for users within the system, ensuring compliance with security standards.

fields.name: txtCurrentPassword
fields.description: Field for entering the current password.

fields.name: txtNewPassword
fields.description: Field for entering the new password.
validations: Must be at least 12 characters long.
Must contain a combination of letters and digits.
Must contain upper and lower case letters.
Must contain at least one symbol.

fields.name: txtNewPassword2
fields.description: Field for confirming the new password.

fields.name: chkPolicy
fields.description: Checkbox to agree to user policies.

actors.description: The user attempting to change their password.
The system validating and processing the password change request.

workflows.name: Change Password Workflow
steps: User enters the new password and confirms it.
User checks the policy agreement checkbox.
System validates the password fields and policy agreement.
If validation passes, the system changes the password and redirects the user.

business_rules: User must agree to policies before changing the password.
New password must differ from the current password.

validations.name: Password Length
validations.description: Password must be at least 12 characters long.

validations.name: Password Composition
validations.description: Password must contain a combination of letters, digits, upper and lower case letters, and symbols.

validations.name: Policy Agreement
validations.description: User must check policy agreement checkbox.

system_behavior: Redirects user based on session details after a successful password change.
Displays error messages for invalid input or failed validation.

dependencies.name: UserSession
dependencies.description: Stores session information for the user.

dependencies.name: Security
dependencies.description: Handles password security checks and changes.

exceptions.name: Validation Failure
exceptions.description: Occurs when user inputs do not meet required validations.
